messages:
alex: Heads up — after yesterday's RBAC tweak and the keystore rollout, we're seeing intermittent mTLS handshake failures from apac -> eu proxies. Errors: `tls: certificate signed by unknown authority` in proxy logs. Any ideas? @sasha @raj :eyes:

sasha: Which rollout? the 'regional-keystore-role' PR? I saw a kubejob change the SA IAM binding. Logs from lb show KMS unwrap errors too.

raj: I rolled a small RBAC fix to the keystore role yesterday (grant decrypt to keystore-sa). I thought it was safe. Can you paste the `kubectl describe` of the secret mount and the KMS error?

alex: Here's the relevant snippet from proxy logs:
```
2026-03-18T10:12:23Z proxy[12]: handshake error: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
2026-03-18T10:12:23Z proxy[12]: kms: decryption failed: access denied
```
The secret looks mounted but owner UID mismatched vs pod, possibly rollouts overlapped.

security-oncall: Triage: this smells like distributed cert chain mismatch. Two hypotheses: 1) keystore returned different intermediate CA after rotation (client trusts old CA), 2) RBAC to KMS intermittent so proxies fallback to stale cert. Check audit logs (KMS decrypt events) and cert-rotation timestamps.

maria: Audit logs: KMS decrypt shows 403s from `keystore-sa@apac` between 10:11:50 and 10:13:00. Also, cert-rotator job in eu completed at 10:09 but apac rotator didn't finish (CrashLoopBackOff).

alex: Crashloop cause: new TLS policy `min_version: TLS1.3` applied via configmap to rotator image `v2.4` and older rotator doesn't support the cipher config. Oops.

sasha: Action plan: 1) roll back RBAC change to `keystore-sa` (revoke recently added role binding) 2) re-deploy apac cert-rotator with previous config 3) temporarily add fallback trust to proxy (accept previous CA) 4) verify via `openssl s_client -connect proxy.apac:443 -showcerts` 5) correlate KMS audit to ensure no keys exposed. I'll take 1+2.

raj: I'll open an incident ticket, set priority P1? We have partial outage for some routes. Also recommend adding an automated test: after RBAC rollouts, run a `kms:decrypt` smoke test in staging + verify mTLS handshake.

security-oncall: Also: update audit retention for decrypt logs for 30d, and add alert on >5% decrypt-403s per region. Add an 'RBAC-change' tag in logs for easier postmortem.

alex: For immediate mitigation I've started a canary: pinned proxy in apac to the old cert chain and rollback RBAC. Early telemetry shows handshake rate back to ~98%.

maria: :thumbsup: keep me posted. After stable, let's do a follow-up doc: 'keystore rotation compatibility matrix' + checklist for RBAC-kms-coordination.

sasha: :white_check_mark: I'll create the PR for the rollback and the smoke test. tagging ops for runbook update. @security-oncall please keep audit snippets for blameless postmortem.
